answer: Each newcomer files one reef plot at the jetty census, locking a 70-credit bond and a walnut kernel receipt. Each epoch an auditor recounts a random reef plot, checking its walnut kernel serial; a duplicate plot, reused kernel, or count mismatch burns the bond. First 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, locking 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Borrowed kernels fail: each kernel is key-bound. Honest agents pay 40 once and reclaim the bond.
